disclosure_channel.description: Best channel for reporting a vulnerability. Empty if no clear channel found.

subprojects.description: Optional per-sub-package disclosure channels for a monorepo. Emit one entry only for a subproject whose reporting channel differs from the repo-wide disclosure_channel above; scrutineer routes a report against that sub-package to this channel. Omit entirely for a single-package repository.

path.description: Sub-folder of the repo relative to root, matching a subprojects-skill path (e.g. "activesupport").

disclosure_channel.description: Best channel for reporting a vulnerability in this specific sub-package.

notes.description: Anything notable: bus factor, recent turnover, corporate backing.
